hero.title: A calm control surface for reviewable paper workflows.
hero.summary: One authenticated local workspace connects the existing backend-owned research, governance, paper, portfolio, comparison, and lifecycle workflows.

boundary.title: Review first. Operate deliberately.
boundary.description: The browser uses the versioned FastAPI contract through a fixed same-origin gateway. Completed artifacts and backend domain services remain authoritative.

startup.title: Standard or isolated Demo Workspace
startup.description: Operators choose clean real-user storage or a separately named disposable Demo volume. This page never seeds or initializes either workspace.

health.title: API connectivity
health.checkingMessage: Checking the FastAPI process through the same-origin gateway…
health.availableMessage: The local API process is responding on the versioned health endpoint.
health.unavailableGuidance: Start FastAPI on loopback, then retry.

firstRun.checkingStandard: Checking the Standard Workspace for saved evidence…
firstRun.dataUnavailableTitle: Workspace data is unavailable, not empty
firstRun.standardAvailableDescription: Continue with the review workspaces below. These records are not automatically connected to one another.
firstRun.emptyTitle: The application is running, but no workspace evidence has been loaded yet.
firstRun.emptyDescription: Empty is a valid first-run state. It differs from an unavailable, invalid, or failed research root, evidence root, or product database.
firstRun.emptyGuidance: Choose either the isolated Demo Workspace through the documented terminal commands, or load or create real artifacts through documented operator workflows. This page never seeds data, writes artifacts, or initializes storage.
firstRun.demoWarning: Demo only — disposable example evidence, not real user data or trading advice.
firstRun.comparisonStep: {step}. Compare the two ordered demo results
firstRun.lifecycleStep: {step}. Prepare a proposal and record explicit human decision evidence
firstRun.demoBoundary: Each link comes from the validated backend descriptor. No fixture identity or evidence payload is defined in the browser.

hero.title: See workspace truth, then choose the next safe review.
hero.summary: Independent read regions preserve backend order, raw values, partial availability, and explicit human control. This Dashboard never runs a command, ranks a strategy, or claims live-trading readiness.

identity.title: What workspace am I in?
identity.description: Mode, active language, and local access framing remain explicit.
identity.demoWarning: Disposable example evidence only. It is not real user data or trading advice.
identity.standardDescription: Standard mode uses local product storage. Independent records are not assumed to form one workflow chain.

readiness.title: Is the product healthy and configured?
readiness.description: Process health and product dependencies remain separate. A successful health request is not complete product readiness.
readiness.processOnly: The FastAPI process responded. Research, evidence, and product-database readiness are reported separately.
readiness.identityResolved: Workspace mode resolved through the bounded Demo descriptor behavior.
readiness.emptySource: The request succeeded and this source is healthy but empty.
readiness.availableSource: The request succeeded with {count} source records.

summaryDetail.apiUnavailable: The API process is unreachable and no independent required read has succeeded. Inspect the source errors before retrying.
summaryDetail.partial: At least one product source succeeded and at least one failed. Inspect and retry only the failed source.
summaryDetail.unavailable: Required product sources failed. This is not an empty workspace.
summaryDetail.loading: Unresolved sources are loading. Previously completed success or failure evidence remains part of the readiness summary.
summaryDetail.populated: All required reads succeeded and at least one source returned records. This says nothing about strategy quality.
summaryDetail.healthyEmpty: All required reads succeeded and returned no records. Empty is a valid configured state.

attention.title: Which explicit conditions may need attention?
attention.description: Only allow-listed backend conditions appear. Attention is workflow navigation, not an opinion about performance.
attention.empty: No allow-listed attention condition is currently visible from the loaded reads.
attention.boundary: The Dashboard has no durable lifecycle current-state contract and never claims persistent pending lifecycle reviews.

items.emptyEvidence: Healthy workspace without research or evidence

details.queued: Inspect the exact job before making an explicit Run decision on its detail page.
details.failed: Inspect the exact failure and available manual controls on the job detail page.
details.running: Inspect the active job and its latest attempt. The Dashboard does not poll or recover it.
details.interrupted: Inspect the existing manual recovery workflow on the exact job page.
details.result: The backend-owned result_available flag permits exact Portfolio Record inspection.
details.emptyEvidence: Choose a documented workflow or browse the separate research and evidence areas.
details.dependency: Inspect the failed read, stable code, request ID, and bounded recovery guidance.

jobs.title: What Paper Job activity exists?
jobs.description: A bounded list preserves exact backend order and duplicates. Operational success is not financial success.
jobs.loading: Loading the bounded Paper Job list…
jobs.empty: The product database request succeeded and returned no Paper Jobs.
jobs.ariaLabel: Recent Paper Jobs in backend order
jobs.allJobs: Open the complete Paper Job list

results.title: Continue explicit result review
results.description: Only backend-owned result availability creates a candidate. Selection is manual, ordered, distinct by job ID, and side-effect free.
results.loading: Checking result availability from Paper Jobs…
results.empty: No loaded Paper Job currently reports result_available=true.
results.legend: Select available results in the order to compare
results.helper: Select two to four distinct nonblank job IDs. Duplicate backend rows remain visible, but a selected ID can appear only once in Comparison.
results.blankUnavailable: A blank job ID remains visible but cannot be selected.
results.duplicateSelected: Job ID {jobId} is already selected from another duplicate backend row.
results.maximumSelected: Four distinct job IDs are selected. Deselect one before choosing {jobId}.
results.selected: {count, plural, =0 {No results selected} one {# result selected} other {# results selected}}
results.boundary: No result is auto-selected, ranked, scored, recommended, or recomputed in the browser.

research.title: Saved research in source order
research.description: This source remains separate from governance evidence; no cross-source chronology is fabricated.
research.empty: The research request succeeded and returned no saved runs.
research.ariaLabel: Research runs in exact endpoint order

evidence.title: Saved evidence manifests in source order
evidence.description: Manifest type, artifact key, schema, raw identity, order, and duplicates remain authoritative.
evidence.empty: The evidence request succeeded and returned no manifests.
evidence.ariaLabel: Evidence manifests in exact endpoint order

workflow.title: What safe workflow action can I choose next?
workflow.description: Demo uses exact descriptor relationships. Standard mode offers generic browse choices without connecting unrelated records.
workflow.standardBoundary: Choose a product area deliberately. Standard records remain independent unless an authoritative contract relates them.
workflow.commandBoundary: Dashboard actions navigate, inspect, refresh reads, or prepare a comparison URL. They never submit, Run, Retry, Recover, Cancel, propose, or review a command.

standard.jobs: {step}. Browse or open Paper Job submission
standard.lifecycle: {step}. Open the non-executing Lifecycle Review workspace

demo.lifecycle: {step}. Open Lifecycle Review with descriptor examples

technical.title: Explicit read ownership
technical.description: Each source can be refreshed independently. Newer explicit reads suppress stale responses.
technical.boundary: There is no background polling, global Dashboard cache, local-storage persistence, aggregate readiness API, or Dashboard command request.
